sentences.text: Thanda paani neeche doob jaata hai.
Toh phir frozen paani float karke upar kyun rehta hai?
Dekho ek lake ko, autumn mein.
Upar ka surface water thanda hota hai, bhaari hota hai, aur doob jaata hai.
Ye tab tak chalta hai, jab tak poori lake lagbhag chaar degree pe na aa jaaye.
Phir rule palat jaata hai.
Chaar degree se neeche, paani thanda hone pe halka hota jaata hai.
Sabse thanda paani upar rehta hai, aur wahin ice banti hai.
Kyun?
Ye dekhne ke liye zoom in karo.
Liquid paani mein molecules ek doosre ke paas se ludhakte hue nikalte hain.
Unke beech ke weak bonds toot jaate hain aur phir se ban jaate hain, ek second ke trillionth hisse se bhi kam mein.
Isliye kuch bhi ek jagah ruka nahi rehta.
Inhe freeze karo, aur har oxygen apne chaar padosiyon se jud jaata hai.
Ye bonds milkar rings banate hain, har ring mein chheh, aur ye layer pe layer jam jaate hain.
Ye cage khula hua hai.
Molecules ab zyada door baithte hain, liquid se bhi zyada door.
Toh wahi paani ab leta hai, lagbhag nau percent zyada jagah.
Wahi paani, zyada jagah.
Isliye ice apne aas paas ke paani se halki ho jaati hai, aur upar aa jaati hai.
Ye tairta hua dhakkan neeche ke paani ko insulate karta hai, isliye talaab aksar poore nahi jamte.
Ice isliye tairti hai, kyunki jamte waqt paani khulkar ek cage ban jaata hai, jo usi paani se halka hai jisse wo bana.
